text.p: Portuguese state-owned electricity firm EDP-Electricidade de Portugal boosted its 1996 consolidated net profit by 22.3 percent to 81.1 billion escudos, a statement said.
Sales of electrical energy and services in 1996 were 546.9 billion escudos, up 1.5 percent compared with 1995.
Cash flow stood at 201.6 billion escudos and investments were more than 100 billion escudos, EDP said. It gave no comparative figures for 1995.

"At the end of 1996, the total debt was 683.1 billion escudos, which represents a drop of 9.5 billion escudos, despite the great financial effort in the areas of investment and internationalisation," the statement said.
The Socialist government plans to privatise up to 49 percent of EDP this summer.
